name: Stormbringer: Stormy Days, Surge Overload and Improved Body of Lightning work natively (#1027, #1674, #2803)
contract: Three Stormbringer passives read as 'not implemented' by a source-id grep but are each delivered end to end by the engine's generic spell-modifier system, with no module or script code involved. #1027 Stormy Days (705655) is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 19 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25%, class mask word2 bit 4 matching exactly Conjure Storm (800227, ranks 501415-501420) and its Lesser/Rainstorm variants; AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:713-720) applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the amplitude of every periodic aura the caster owns, so Conjure Storm's 2000 ms tick becomes 2000*(1-0.25)=1500 ms. #1674 Surge Overload (300596) is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 12 SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = +1, class mask word1 bit 5 matching exactly Body of Lightning (500041); SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 reaches effect index 1's value through SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue -> Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (SpellInfo.cpp:520, Unit.cpp:12148-12166 case 1), and effect 1 of 500041 is SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_POWER whose base value of 1 (percent of max mana per tick) becomes 2. #2803 Improved Body of Lightning (705693) is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 11 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -30001 + DieSides 1 = -30000 ms, class mask word1 bits 5 and 22 matching Body of Lightning (500041, RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime both 90000) and its inert damage half (800406, no cooldown); Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns (Player.cpp:11450-11457) applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both the spell and category cooldowns since 500041 does not carry SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS, so 90000 becomes 60000, exactly the promised 30 sec reduction. All three assertions query the native spell-modifier/effect-value chain directly (CoAGameplayTest.cpp), so none of the target spells needs to be learned or cast, and none of the expected values depends on stats.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
BASELINE #1027: Conjure Storm ticks at the unmodified 2000 ms without Stormy Days
DISCRIMINATING #1027: Stormy Days speeds Conjure Storm's tick to 1500 ms (-25% of the DBC amplitude)
BASELINE #1674: Body of Lightning's mana-per-tick effect value is the unmodified 1% without Surge Overload
DISCRIMINATING #1674: Surge Overload raises the mana-per-tick effect value to 2%
BASELINE #2803: Body of Lightning's cooldown is the unmodified 90000 ms without Improved Body of Lightning
DISCRIMINATING #2803: Improved Body of Lightning cuts the cooldown to 60000 ms (-30000 ms from the DBC BasePoints/DieSides)
